summary: Recovered the stalled progress/throughput compiler opportunity with an exact deterministic compiler contract. The design now defines source inputs, normalization/deduplication, computability/UNKNOWN semantics, metric formulas, minimal privacy-safe human event instrumentation, event-driven critic triggers, two-hour and generation projections, and a falsifiable canary suite. No percentage or human-intervention value is invented when evidence is absent.
checkpoints_completed: CP1 exact progress-event and throughput sources loaded
CP2 deterministic source normalization and unknown semantics defined
CP3 metric formulas and human intervention/routing event contract defined
CP4 critic-trigger state machine plus time/generation projections defined
CP5 canary fixtures, falsifiers and independent reconstruction rules defined
CP6 durable RETURN persisted; only this recovery run may be closed

implementation_target.determinism_rule: Identical pinned source bytes + identical as_of + compiler version must produce logically identical output independent of directory enumeration order.

authoritative_inputs: typed Steward/parent consumption or integration disposition artifacts
active opportunity queue files with explicit generation/provenance metadata
append-only minimal human-action events when present

normalization.timestamp_basis: Parse RFC3339/ISO8601 offsets and normalize to UTC for computation; renderers may localize later.
normalization.stable_record_key: schema + durable source_ref + intrinsic identity (event_id/run_id/return_ref/claim path/generation_id).
normalization.directory_order: sort normalized records by occurred_at_utc, then source_ref, then stable_record_key
normalization.invalid_record_rule: Do not silently drop malformed material evidence. Exclude it from positive metrics and emit an integrity_error entry with source_ref and reason.
normalization.generation_assignment: Use explicit generation_id or queue/generation provenance only. Never infer generation from timestamp proximity.
normalization.root_assignment: Use explicit project_id/root/surface identity only. Unknown remains null.
normalization.unknown_rule: Evidence absence is UNKNOWN/null, never numeric zero, false success or inferred failure.
normalization.dedup_rule: A material transition is counted once by stable source transition identity. Replay/retry of the same source bytes cannot multiply progress.

derived_progress_events.requires: durable run + valid claim/recovery claim lineage
explicit positive scope-aware disposition; missing disposition never counts
explicit state transition with evidence refs
eligibility evidence plus recovery return; stale claim alone is not recovered
stable emitted opportunity identity and provenance

metric_definitions.name: durable_returns
metric_definitions.formula: count distinct valid return_ref/run_id pairs in window
metric_definitions.unknown_rule: 0 is valid only after the source roots were successfully scanned

metric_definitions.name: integrated_returns
metric_definitions.formula: count distinct return_refs with explicit positive typed integration/consumption disposition in window

metric_definitions.name: useful_durable_results
metric_definitions.formula: count distinct return_refs with versioned disposition mapping to USEFUL (for current legacy evidence, ADOPT_* maps USEFUL; rejected/conflicted/deferred/not-applicable map non-useful or deferred; unknown labels remain UNKNOWN)
metric_definitions.unknown_rule: returns without a recognized explicit disposition are excluded from numerator and reported as unresolved

metric_definitions.name: claims_started
metric_definitions.formula: count distinct STARTED runs whose claim_ref resolves to a valid normal or recovery claim
metric_definitions.unknown_rule: claim without STARTED does not count

metric_definitions.name: duplicate_claim_collisions_safely_recovered
metric_definitions.formula: count durable collision/claim-attempt receipts proving a lost create-if-absent race followed by safe reload/retry
metric_definitions.unknown_rule: cannot infer collisions from final unique claim files alone

metric_definitions.name: stale_attempts_detected
metric_definitions.formula: count distinct original attempts with durable stale/recovery eligibility evidence under the active threshold policy at as_of
metric_definitions.unknown_rule: silence below threshold or without STARTED is not stale

metric_definitions.name: stale_attempts_recovered
metric_definitions.formula: count distinct original attempts with eligible recovery claim plus completed recovery return
metric_definitions.unknown_rule: recovery claim without return is not recovered

metric_definitions.name: stage_gates_advanced
metric_definitions.formula: count explicit gate state transitions from non-pass to pass/cleared with evidence refs
metric_definitions.unknown_rule: architecture prose or new file existence alone does not advance a gate

metric_definitions.name: blockers_cleared
metric_definitions.formula: count stable blocker/dependency identities whose durable state transitions blocked->cleared
metric_definitions.unknown_rule: do not infer from unrelated downstream activity

metric_definitions.name: opportunities_generated_automatically
metric_definitions.formula: count emitted opportunities whose provenance explicitly identifies deterministic Planner/compiler generation from durable inputs and no human task-semantics source
metric_definitions.unknown_rule: absence of provenance is UNKNOWN, not manual or automatic

metric_definitions.name: opportunities_generated_manually
metric_definitions.formula: count opportunities with explicit HUMAN/PARENT_SEEDED provenance
metric_definitions.unknown_rule: legacy opportunities without provenance remain UNKNOWN

metric_definitions.name: automatic_next_wave_ratio
metric_definitions.formula: automatic / (automatic + manual) when both provenance classes are fully known for the comparison set
metric_definitions.unknown_rule: null when denominator is zero or provenance coverage is incomplete

metric_definitions.name: human_interventions
metric_definitions.formula: count deduplicated human-action events whose action_type has counts_as_intervention=true
metric_definitions.unknown_rule: null when human event ledger coverage is absent/incomplete; never substitute chat count

metric_definitions.name: human_routing_actions
metric_definitions.formula: count human-action events tagged MANUAL_WORKER_ROUTING, MANUAL_RESULT_TRANSPORT, MANUAL_BATCH_DESIGN or MANUAL_MERGE_REQUEST
metric_definitions.unknown_rule: null if ledger coverage is absent

metric_definitions.name: useful_durable_results_per_human_intervention
metric_definitions.unknown_rule: null if human_interventions is unknown or zero; expose numerator/denominator separately

metric_definitions.name: context_receipt_coverage
metric_definitions.formula: material STARTED runs with valid context_receipt / material STARTED runs in window
metric_definitions.unknown_rule: null if run schema version makes denominator ambiguous; report numerator/denominator

metric_definitions.name: roots_active
metric_definitions.formula: count distinct explicit project/root ids with a material claim/STARTED/return/integration event in window
metric_definitions.unknown_rule: do not infer roots from filenames

metric_definitions.name: next_generation_generated_without_human
metric_definitions.formula: true only when generation N+1 output has explicit compiler provenance from N durable inputs and the causal interval contains zero MANUAL_BATCH_DESIGN or human-authored task-semantics events
metric_definitions.unknown_rule: UNKNOWN until both compiler provenance and human-event coverage are sufficient

human_event_contract.suggested_storage: coordination/telemetry/human-events/<event_id>.json or another append-only owner selected by current authority
human_event_contract.privacy_rule: Record action metadata only. Never copy raw prompt/transcript/private content into the event.
human_event_contract.dedup_rule: Platform/source action identity when available; otherwise stable hash of coarse metadata without private text. Replayed ingestion must not increment counts.

critic_trigger_engine.evaluation: tri-state TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN per trigger at a pinned as_of; any TRUE requires a fresh critic opportunity unless one is already validly active for the same trigger set. UNKNOWN is surfaced, never silently treated as FALSE.

triggers.rule: durable RETURNs since last completed strategic critic >= 10
a Planner generation output reaches terminal generation compilation/end state
useful_durable_results_per_human_intervention is computable and fails to improve across two comparable completed generations
at least 2 durable HUMAN_DRIFT_CORRECTION events since last strategic critic
no compatible READY/derived-READY work remains while the same stage gate remains uncleared across the comparison cycle
same stable blocker_id is present in two consecutive Planner generation inputs/receipts
(stale + failed + boundary terminal claimed attempts) / claimed attempts > 0.20 for the generation; denominator must be >0
declared Context Fabric/Planner/Steward behavior version or semantic contract changes materially
parent strategic receipt chooses WAIT while allocator evidence shows compatible safe READY work

critic_trigger_engine.anti_recursion: A completed strategic critic resets the 10-return backstop baseline. Critic returns do not by themselves recursively demand another critic unless another independent trigger remains TRUE.

two_hour_bucket.rendering: UI may display local timezone labels without changing bucket membership
two_hour_bucket.contents: event counts by meaningful type plus evidence refs; no percent-complete field

generation_series.unscoped_rule: records lacking explicit generation provenance remain in UNSCOPED and are not guessed into a generation

output_schema_candidate.truth_boundary: This report is a projection. It cannot make Current/Human Accepted/Served or integration authority decisions.

cases: Replay identical claim/run/return inputs twice -> identical report and no doubled events.
RETURN exists without Steward disposition -> durable_returns increments; integrated_returns does not.
No human-event ledger -> human_interventions and useful_per_intervention are null/UNKNOWN, not zero/infinity.
Duplicate ingestion of one human event with same dedup_key -> counted once.
Nine returns after last critic -> TEN_RETURN_BACKSTOP false; tenth -> true; completed critic resets baseline.
STARTED attempt age 19m59s -> not stale; 20m -> suspect metric eligible; 30m plus retry-safe/no-return -> recovery eligible; only completed recovery return increments stale_recovered.
Generated opportunity without explicit compiler provenance -> automatic/manual classification UNKNOWN.
Same timestamps and source bytes under shuffled filesystem enumeration -> identical two-hour buckets/report.
Private human source text absent from emitted report and events; only sanitized metadata survives.
Late original RETURN after recovery -> both immutable returns remain evidence; no newest-wins collapse; reconciliation remains a separate Steward action.
Failed canary event remains visible after later unrelated successes and cannot be converted into positive progress.
Out-of-schema/malformed material source -> integrity_errors populated and positive metric is not fabricated.
canary.pass_condition: All deterministic/idempotence/privacy/unknown-semantics/critic-trigger cases pass from a pinned fixture head with byte-stable logical output.

truth_boundary.what_is_proven: A deterministic, falsifiable, privacy-safe compiler contract now exists and is durable; the stale attempt was safely recovered append-only.
truth_boundary.what_is_not_proven: No executable progress compiler code or live human-event instrumentation was built by this opportunity's isolated write scope. Metrics remain projections until implementation/canary execution proves them.

remaining_boundaries: Implement the recovered contract in an authorized candidate code/test scope.
Select/authorize the append-only owner for human-action events before live instrumentation.
Replace legacy ADOPT_* utility mapping with the typed Steward disposition schema when that bridge becomes operational.
Run independent verifier on the implementation before any claim that progress metrics are operational.
